verdict.rationale: Ramp's QuickBooks integration syncs "accounting fields, transactions, reimbursements... in real time" and includes a reconciliation tool. Ramp also has dedicated NetSuite and Xero integration pages, transactions are auto-coded to GL accounts, and accounting categories, tracking categories, departments and entities are first-class objects, with multi-entity sync in one step. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-controlled GL/class/department mapping configuration, confirmation that NetSuite and Xero sync card transactions (their pages only describe bill workflows), any mention of class mapping specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
